title: list_agents — input
description: Input schema for the SOX list_agents operation. Returns the server-tracked liveness records for all agents known to this server, optionally filtered by presence state. Normative reference: spec/primitives/presence.md §2.

status_filter.description: If set, return only agents whose current server-derived presence state is one of the listed values. Omit to return all agents regardless of state.

namespace.description: If set, return only agents whose identity was authenticated within this namespace. Omit to return agents across all namespaces visible to the caller.
